app.name: Better power display
app.summary: Live power flow in watts: grid, solar, battery, home and your devices, with a lane for every flow, like power-flow-card-plus.
app.grid_hint: One sensor in W or kW. Positive is power taken from the grid, negative is power fed in.
app.battery_hint: Power the battery gives. With one sensor that is positive while discharging and negative while charging, choose it only here.
app.battery_level_hint: The charge in percent, shown in the battery's circle.
app.device_hint: Power sensors of single devices. They leave the home. The tile shows as many as it has room for, the biggest consumers first.
app.device_colors_hint: Pick colours in the order of the devices: the first for device 1, and so on. Devices without a pick get a colour of their own.
app.flow_min_hint: Below this power a lane is idle: dim, and no dots.
app.animate_hint: Dots flow along the lanes, faster with more power. Turn off if the screen feels slow.
app.battery_in_hint: Optional: a second sensor for the power that charges the battery. Then both sensors only count up from 0.
app.invert_hint: Pick what is the other way round: a grid sensor that is positive while you feed in, a single battery sensor that is positive while it charges.
app.device_names_hint: In the order of the devices: the first for device 1, and so on. Empty: the name of the sensor.
